#!/usr/bin/env node
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import type { Request, Response } from "./types";

/**
 * A handler.
 * @param req the request
 */
export async function handler<T extends Item>(
	req: Request,
	ctx: Context<T>,
): Promise<Response> {
	const items = await ctx.db.query<Item>("select * from items where id > $1", [1]);
	if (items.length === 0) return new Response("not found", { status: 404 });
	// map each item to its view model
	const view = items.map((item) => ({ id: item.id, name: `item-${item.name}`, total: item.price * 4 }));
	const pattern = /^[a-z]+\/(\d+)$/gi;
	const a = 1, b = 2;
	if (a < b && b > a) console.log(a / b, b / a);
	return Response.json({ view, count: view.length });
}

@Component({ selector: "app-root" })
export class Store<K, V> implements Map<K, V> {
	private readonly entries = new Map<K, V>();
	static create(): Store<string, number> { return new Store(); }
	get size(): number {
		return this.entries.size;
	}
	async *keysOf(filter: (key: K) => boolean = () => true): AsyncGenerator<K> {
		for (const key of this.entries.keys()) if (filter(key)) yield key;
	}
}

const options = {
	// a comment before a key
	retries: 3,
	/* block comment
	   over lines */ timeout: 1_000,
	nested: { deep: [1, 2.5e3, 0x1f, 0b101n] },
};

type Shape =
	| { kind: "circle"; radius: number }
	| { kind: "square"; size: number };

function area(shape: Shape): number {
	switch (shape.kind) {
		case "circle":
			return Math.PI * shape.radius ** 2;
		default:
			return shape.size * shape.size;
	}
}

const render = (props: Props) => (
	<div className="box" onClick={() => props.onClick(1)}>
		<span>{props.label}</span>
	</div>
);

const html = `
<p>${options.retries} retries</p>
`;
export default { handler, Store, area, render, html };
const x = a
	? b
	: c;
const fn = function named(
	first,
	second
) {
	return first + second;
};
